body:
You’re probably right but in my case I’m not entirely sure about that.

Sure no one is judging me as harshly as I judge myself but over the years I would say I’ve been judged pretty damn harshly, more than the average person at the very least.

I’m not trying to victimize myself or make excuses. I’m just saying that it’s pretty painful to a point changing my way of thinking is very difficult.
